scope: Direct Computer Use input in ordinary Windows GUI; paused generated 120-second audio, monitor 2 only
observations: Cold startup with the unchanged copied saved policy reached paused music with the bottom controls hidden.
A blank-canvas click revealed the bottom controls at clock 00:00:00 and duration 00:02:00; a later screenshot showed them hidden again.
Modifier-only Shift input revealed the bottom controls; this screenshot check does not measure the exact keyboard timeout.
A click in the observed blank bottom-bar gap left the pointer over the bar; it stayed visible beyond the saved two-second delay.
A blank-canvas click left the bottom-bar hover area; later observation showed the controls hidden again.
The paused music input and displayed zero clock were preserved throughout.
Ctrl+Q ended the process normally with exit code zero; no forced cleanup was used.
